g01-platform-4.observed_description: Ana in her green overshirt stands with a dark-blue rolling suitcase on a platform beside a silver train with open doors; a big square sign with a white 4 hangs above, and a small far sign repeats the 4.
g01-platform-4.note: Usable: platform four reads at 180 px and in the 4:5 crop; only the digit 4 appears.

g02-platform-7.observed_description: A red-and-white train at a platform under a big square sign with a white 7.
g02-platform-7.note: REJECTED: the train's nose carries the red digits 720, a second number that competes with the 7; remade as v2 g05.

g03-gate-12.observed_description: Luis in his navy T-shirt with a grey backpack stands by rows of grey seats at an airport gate; a white airplane at the jet bridge shows through the window, and a yellow sign with a black 12 is on the right.
g03-gate-12.note: Usable at 3:2: gate twelve reads at 180 px; the 12 sits outside the centered 4:5 crop, so it is never in a four-picture card.

g04-gate-9.observed_description: An empty airport gate with rows of grey seats and a white airplane at the jet bridge behind the window; a yellow sign with a black 9 is on a pillar.
g04-gate-9.note: Usable: gate nine reads at 180 px; the 9 stays inside the 4:5 crop.
